0x10270B60.name: StAvatar_InitGlobals
0x10270B60.evidence: writes its default values to the avatar globals at DAT_1099B0D8..DAT_1099B138, DAT_1099C510 and DAT_1099CDB4, calls sqxfXformTD_Init and sqxfXformTD_Update on the per-part transforms, calls the setup functions FUN_1028e350, FUN_10290610, FUN_1026e2f0 and FUN_10272ba0, and ends by calling FUN_10272a10(4); called by StAvatarInit
0x10270B60.summary: Sets the avatar's default globals and per-part transforms.

0x10270EC0.name: StAvatar_UpdateTransform
0x10270EC0.evidence: copies the eight values of the selected 0x7C-byte block (index DAT_1099B0F4) into DAT_1099CD94..DAT_1099CDB0 and calls sqxfXformTD_Update on 0x1099CD38; called by fn_10270B60 and fn_10271030
0x10270EC0.summary: Copies the selected part's values and updates its transform.

0x10270F30.name: StAvatar_Update
0x10270F30.evidence: when flag 8 is set calls StAvatar_ApplyModes and StAvatar_ApplyEffectFlags and clears the flag; when flag 0x100 is set calls fn_10273560; clears bits 0xF00 of DAT_1099B0D8, calls fn_1026E590, then for the five parts with flag 2 updates the transforms with fn_1027B170 and sqxfXformTD_Update; called by fn_1024DB60
0x10270F30.summary: Updates the avatar's parts for one frame.

0x10271030.name: StAvatar_ApplyModes
0x10271030.evidence: when flag 0x200 is set calls FUN_102712e0 with the stored values and the argument; otherwise derives a mode from flags 0x40 and 0x80 and calls FUN_102710b0 with it, then StAvatar_UpdateTransform when flag 0x20 or a mode is set
0x10271030.summary: Applies the avatar's current display modes.

0x102715F0.name: StAvatar_ApplyEffectFlags
0x102715F0.evidence: derives a value from flags 0x10 and 0x20 of DAT_1099B0D8 and calls FUN_10271630 with the stored values when it is non-zero

0x10271630.name: StAvatar_UpdateAngles
0x10271630.evidence: when flag 2 of the part at DAT_1099C514 is clear, converts the argument to a frame rate, derives two angles scaled by the half sizes of the arguments and 0.01745 (pi/180), builds the rotations with FUN_1027ac30 and FUN_1027b170 and updates two transforms with sqxfXformTD_Update
0x10271630.summary: Converts the view angles into part rotations and updates the transforms.

0x102717F0.name: StAvatar_DrawScene

0x10271B90.name: StAvatar_UpdateFlagBits
0x10271B90.evidence: with the second argument -1 toggles the bits of the argument in DAT_1099B0D8, non-zero sets them and zero clears them; called by fn_10250800
0x10271B90.summary: Sets, clears or toggles flag bits of the avatar state.

0x10271C30.name: StAvatar_SetOffsets
0x10271C30.evidence: stores the two arguments in DAT_1099B0E4 and DAT_1099B0EC at the index argument and sets flag 8 in DAT_1099B0D8 when either is non-zero; called by fn_1024DD10
0x10271C30.summary: Stores a pair of offsets for an index and flags the change.

0x10271C60.name: StAvatar_SetSceneValue1
0x10271C60.evidence: calls fn_102907C0 on the scene at 0x1099B13C with the two arguments; called by StAvatarInit

0x10271C80.name: StAvatar_SetSceneValue2

0x10271CA0.evidence: stores its nine arguments in DAT_1099B104..DAT_1099B124
0x10271CA0.summary: Stores nine parameter values in the avatar globals.

0x10271D00.name: StAvatar_StoreEntry
0x10271D00.evidence: copies the nine stored parameters (DAT_1099B104..DAT_1099B124) into the 9-dword entry of DAT_103B1C10 at the index DAT_1099B128

0x10271D70.name: StAvatar_SelectEntry
0x10271D70.evidence: stores the current entry first when DAT_1099B128 is not 0xD, loads entry param_1 of DAT_103B1C10 with StAvatar_StoreParams, applies the flags with FUN_102712e0 when flag 0x200 is set, and sets DAT_1099B128 to the argument

0x10271F20.name: StAvatar_InitEntry
0x10271F20.evidence: when DAT_1099BB70 is at most 0, sets the entry's transform from FUN_102727f0 and the table at DAT_103B1B70, initialises two transforms with sqxfXformTD_Init and Update and sets the scale at +0x2C to 0x41A00000

0x102725A0.name: StAvatar_SetEntryPosition
0x102725A0.evidence: replaces the index with DAT_1099B0F8 when it is -1, calls FUN_1028dbb0 on the argument, stores the first float and the second dword in the 0x7C-byte entry at DAT_1099BF20, and updates its transform
0x102725A0.summary: Sets the position of one avatar part entry.

0x10272630.name: StAvatar_SetEntryFlag
0x10272630.evidence: calls FUN_1028ecc0 on the scene with the handle at DAT_1099BB74 for the index, setting or clearing it from the argument (-1 toggles against DAT_1099B164)

0x102726E0.name: StAvatar_SetFlag3
0x102726E0.evidence: calls FUN_1028ece0 on the scene with the handle 3, setting it from the argument (-1 toggles against the byte at DAT_1099B184+0x9C)

0x10272750.evidence: when flag 1 of the part at DAT_1099C514 is set, changes its flag 2 from the argument (-1 toggles, 0 clears, else sets), and when it is set updates the transform with FUN_1027a700, FUN_1027afb0 and FUN_1027b170
0x10272750.summary: Sets or clears the second flag of an avatar part.

0x102727F0.name: StAvatar_SetEntryColor
0x102727F0.evidence: stores the four dwords of the argument at DAT_1099BBB0 for the index, and when DAT_1099CCF8 is set writes the first three and 1.0 minus the fourth into the scene object's +0x28, +0x2C, +0x30 and +0x44

0x10272880.evidence: when the second argument is set copies its eight dwords from +0x14 to +0x30 into the part's values at DAT_1099BBB0; when the third argument is set copies its matrix, position, direction and scale into the part's blocks through M4fSet, FUN_10274650 and FUN_1027a700

0x10272A10.name: StAvatar_SelectIndex
0x10272A10.evidence: replaces -1 with DAT_1099B0F8, then stores the handle at DAT_1099BB74 for the index in DAT_1099B17C (when DAT_1099B170 is set) or in a new slot from FUN_1028f130, and calls FUN_1028f220 with 4; called by fn_10270B60 and fn_102736E0
